notes.title: EDENS ZERO now available!
notes.notes: [p]The story begins on one of the many planets in the Sakura Cosmos: Granbell, the Kingdom of Dreams, where a boy named Shiki lives alongside androids. After a chance encounter with the video creator Rebecca, he ends up taking off into space…[/p][p][/p][p]This is a 3D action role-playing game based on the space fantasy comic/anime EDENS ZERO by Hiro Mashima, creator of Fairy Tail and Rave Master.[/p][p]The player controls a diverse cast of characters as they embark on an epic adventure across different planets while battling powerful enemies![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45265182/f83ce0d17ff2607c4a74b41cf02d752415c9d73e.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: FAIRY TAIL: 100 Years Quest Collab Quests Arrive!
notes.notes: [p]Characters like Natsu, Lucy, and Happy from FAIRY TAIL: 100 Years Quest appear alongside new characters designed by Hiro Mashima: Maruha and Submerse. [/p][p]Experience a special four-episode storyline packed with high-stakes battles![/p][p][/p][h3]Mysterious Organization Story[/h3][p]Veteran Adventurer Maruha wants you to do a[/p][p]background check on a "criminal that[/p][p]shouldn't exist." Perhaps that's not all...[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45265182/d940642610892fe399f2ac2f63b26f0175c94280.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]Maruha(Voice:Anna Nagase)[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45265182/9a92b03042f84c8995b83685572e8123b142668d.png"][/img][/p][p]A seasoned Adventurer in the Shooting Starlight Guild. She commissions Rebecca and her stellar crew to look into some uncanny incidents.[/p][p][/p][h3]Submerse(Voice:Volcano Ota)[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45265182/0f93d2fc2c948e6e97f562b7cdad919c607d4cac.png"][/img][/p][p]A mysterious figure pulling the strings behind recent strange events. Wields an Ether Gear that shapes dreams into nightmares.[/p]

notes.title: Demo Launches Today!
notes.notes: [p]Get an early look at the game, and start exploring the original manga [b]and anime’s [/b]story[b],[/b] and new game-original quests![/p][p][/p][p]Play your way through different planets as Shiki and Rebecca and experience the first part of this intense and suspenseful story.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45265182/c906eb660ca7836633d70cadf7c1083a4d09e002.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45265182/a56b58d6e4151bf8872d842a5a3f2bf22a464178.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Clear the first two chapters of Story Mode to unlock Exploration Mode on Blue Garden.[/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45265182/5f3218993728959ca5cc2e1b5e101e0f273ca2a3.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45265182/5be452a006addc948d405a8f72e802b50220de0a.jpg"][/img][/carousel][p](Save data from the demo can be imported to carry over progress in the full game.)[/p][p](Achievements cannot be obtained in the trial version.)[/p][p]Demo available for download now![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45265182/bc5ad0d9fe8da236644cb90a81499e89af05c28a.jpg"][/img][/p]
